cohort: 2,169,950 women in the Netherlands between 2000 and 2019 who had a spontaneous vaginal birth of a term, live, cephalic, single infant, without a (previous) caesarean section or assisted vaginal birth
finding: Induction, augmentation, and epidural analgesia in obstetrician-led care may be an explanatory factor for the higher incidence of severe perineal trauma among primiparous women in midwife-led care.
